welcome.title: Let's set up your business.
welcome.body: This asks more of you than most apps do — because every answer shapes what you'll see. Nothing here is busywork.
welcome.meta: About 3 minutes · you can add more later

shared.title: What's your name?
shared.subtitle: The one your customers will know you by.

shared.title: How old are you?
shared.subtitle: It tunes the advice to where you are in life.

shared.title: How do you identify?
shared.subtitle: Only ever used to describe you, never to judge.

shared.title: Where are you right now?
shared.subtitle: This decides what the app shows you first.

options.label: I already run a business
options.hint: Bring in your shop and start growing it.

options.label: I'm trying to start one
options.hint: Explore what you could sell — we'll walk you from idea to first sale.

have.title: Describe it in a sentence.
have.subtitle: What you make or do, and who it's for. This is how the app talks about you.

have.title: What kind of business is it?
have.subtitle: It tunes how we score your relationships.

have.title: Where can people buy from you?
have.subtitle: Pick every place that applies.

have.title: Who's your ideal customer?
have.subtitle: Picture one real person. The more specific, the better Growth works.

new.title: What are you drawn to?
new.subtitle: Pick a few — your Discover feed starts here.

new.title: Do you want to make things, or sell them?
new.subtitle: There's no wrong answer — it decides where we point you to source.

options.label: I want to make things
options.hint: Handmade, by me — I'll buy materials.

options.label: I want to sell things
options.hint: Source finished products and resell them.

new.title: Have you done this before?
new.subtitle: Be honest — it changes how much we explain.

options.label: I've tried before
options.hint: I know some of it already.

new.title: What would make this worth it?
new.subtitle: We'll keep it in view as you go.

options.label: A bit of side income
options.hint: A few hundred a month would be great.

options.label: Replace my income
options.hint: I want out of the day job.

options.label: Just to learn
options.hint: I want to see if I can.

new.title: How much time can you give it?
new.subtitle: Honest answers get honest plans.

new.title: What can you start with?
new.subtitle: Plenty of people start at the bottom of this list.

options.label: Almost nothing
options.hint: Under $50 — we'll point you at zero-inventory options.

have.title: Welcome, {name}.
have.body: {biz} is set up. Growth already knows where to look for your customers.

new.title: Welcome, {name}.
new.body: Discover is tuned to what you picked. Find something worth selling and the rest unlocks from there.

finish.note: Anything you skipped lives in the You tab — add it whenever you like.
